title: NO@NYG-card-REFUSED
universal_lens: The fixture-refusal operator defines a projection onto the valid game-slate manifold. When a hypothesized matchup lies outside the confirmed schedule, the system enforces a hard boundary condition, mapping the query to a null-state rather than hallucinating an analytical output.
gsi_mapping: Within GSI, unconfirmed fixtures represent infinite epistemic uncertainty. The conformal prediction intervals for NO@NYG in period six degenerate to the entire sample space. Consequently, the Bayesian posterior collapses into a strict veto state, preventing any probabilistic inference from being emitted.
gse_mapping: In GSE, the situational reasoning engine treats the missing fixture as a forbidden state transition. The dynamic programming graph explicitly prunes branches originating from invalid matchups, ensuring that no downstream tactical or strategic primitives are computed for non-existent temporal nodes.

primitives.name: Fixture Existence Veto Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: # NO@NYG - FIXTURE NOT CONFIRMED (card REFUSED) **This matchup is not a game on the real 6 slate.** The engine does not emit an analyst card for a fixture it cannot confirm.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: S_6: Set of confirmed games at period 6 (dimensionless). m: Matchup tuple (NO, NYG) (dimensionless). I_S(m): Indicator function (dimensionless).
primitives.assumptions: The official league slate S_6 is the ground truth; any matchup not strictly contained within S_6 is considered ontologically void.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breakdown occurs if the scheduling authority retroactively alters S_6 after the veto has been permanently logged and propagated.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a domain-checking operator in functional analysis, where the function evaluates to undefined outside its prescribed domain.
layer2.telemetry: Boolean flag indicating whether the requested matchup exists in the canonical schedule database.

primitives.name: Fiction Prevention Axiom
primitives.verbatim_quote: A card here would be fiction that reads as analysis.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: C: Analyst card output vector (dimensionless). F: Fiction subspace (dimensionless). A: Valid analysis subspace (dimensionless).
primitives.assumptions: The vector space of outputs is strictly partitioned into valid analysis and fiction; there is no continuous interpolation between them.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If the definition of 'analysis' is relaxed to include speculative counterfactuals, the axiom fails to prevent hallucination.

layer2.mapping: Maps to the kernel of the analysis generator, forcing the output norm to zero when input validity is false.
layer2.telemetry: Rate of rejected queries versus total queries processed by the engine.

primitives.name: Temporal Realignment Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Or pass `--week <periodId>` for the week this matchup really belongs to.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: t_req: Requested period index (dimensionless). t_true: Actual period index where matchup occurs (dimensionless).
primitives.assumptions: The matchup is valid in the broader season tensor, merely misaligned in the requested temporal slice.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails if the matchup was permanently canceled and does not exist in any period t.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a coordinate transformation in spacetime, shifting the query along the temporal axis to locate the event.
layer2.telemetry: Success rate of auto-correcting period indices based on team pairing lookups.

When a user queries for the matchup NO@NYG at t=6, the engine computes the intersection of the query with S_6. Finding the intersection empty, the system invokes the Fixture Existence Veto. This is not merely a software error handling routine; it is a rigorous enforcement of epistemic boundaries. If the engine were to proceed, it would necessarily rely on hallucinated priors, generating a distribution over outcomes that has zero correspondence to physical reality. This violates the Fiction Prevention Axiom, which dictates that the probability mass assigned to unconfirmed events must be exactly zero. The refusal to emit a card is therefore a mathematically necessary consequence of maintaining a consistent logical framework. The system then transitions to the Temporal Realignment Protocol, attempting to map the query to a valid t_true where the intersection is non-empty. This ensures that the analytical machinery is only applied to well-posed problems, preserving the integrity of the entire quantitative infrastructure against the corruption of synthetic data.

reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: This primitive traces its lineage to the foundational work in formal logic regarding the principle of non-contradiction and the rejection of vacuous truths. In early statistical mechanics, boundary conditions were strictly enforced to prevent the calculation of impossible microstates. Similarly, modern machine learning guardrails evolved to prevent model hallucination. The fixture-refusal operator is the direct descendant of these safeguards, adapted specifically for the high-stakes domain of sports intelligence, where a single fabricated game could cascade into catastrophic financial and strategic errors.
reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: The engine models the querying agent as a rational actor seeking actionable insights. By refusing the card, the system communicates that the requested information is fundamentally unknowable given the current state of the world. It anticipates that the user might mistakenly believe the engine is simply lacking data, whereas the true issue is ontological absence. The suggested realignment protocol guides the user's mental model toward the correct temporal context, effectively teaching the user the structure of the underlying schedule manifold without requiring explicit instruction.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: Anti-collinearity is maintained by ensuring that the veto signal does not leak into the parameter spaces of valid games. The refusal must be orthogonal to the feature vectors of actual matchups. If the system were to penalize the teams involved in the fake matchup based on their absence, it would introduce a spurious correlation. The cross-layer veto guarantees that the null-state of NO@NYG remains completely isolated, preventing any contamination of the Bayesian priors for the real games involving NYG or NO against their actual opponents.
